# Nishant Hagjer

> Official site of Nishant Hagjer, a drummer, producer and musician from Guwahati, Assam, India, who has played in the heavy metal scene for the past 20 years. He is a Paiste artist, drum teacher and clinician, and offers one-on-one online drum lessons.

Key facts:

- Based in Guwahati, Assam, India. Available for session work, live dates, online lessons and collaborations.
- Has toured Europe, the UK, Australia, New Zealand, Vietnam, Nepal and South East Asia.
- Played Download Festival (UK, 2019) and Bloodstock Festival (UK, 2018) with Underside, and 29 shows in 33 days across 10 European countries with SystemHouse33 (2022).
- Has also played with Undying Inc and Rectified Spirit. Angels of Doom is his own project (debut single "The Underdog", 2023).
- Studied with Benny Greb in 2011 at Swarnabhoomi Academy of Music.
- Endorsements: Paiste cymbals, Mapex drums, Audix microphones, Axis Percussion, SlapKlatz moon gels, Evans drumheads, Promark drumsticks, Hype String cajons, Vratim drumming shoes, Roland V-Drums.
- Contact: nishanthagjer@gmail.com

- [Online lessons](https://www.nishanthagjer.com/online-lessons): request a live one-on-one drum lesson over video call
- [Courses](https://www.nishanthagjer.com/courses): video drum courses, coming soon, with an email sign-up
- [Contact](https://www.nishanthagjer.com/contact): contact form, email and social links
